title: Quartz Raman (CSV)
learn: Two-column CSV with a fluorescence baseline and one cosmic-ray spike at 950 cm⁻¹: try Despike, Baseline and Identify.

title: Calcite Raman (RRUFF text)
learn: RRUFF-style text file with ##KEY=value metadata lines that are skipped automatically.

title: Quartz, calcite, hematite (Excel)
learn: Workbook with several intensity columns: pick one, or add all as separate spectra.

title: Carbonaceous matter Raman (D and G bands)
learn: Synthetic poorly ordered graphite: D1 1350, G 1582, D2 1620 cm⁻¹ on a sloping background (R2 ≈ 0.45). Mark the three bands in Peaks, fit, and read the Beyssac and Kouketsu temperatures.

title: Calcite FTIR (JCAMP-DX)
learn: JCAMP-DX absorbance spectrum stored from 4000 to 400 cm⁻¹; the FTIR axis is shown reversed.

title: Quartz powder XRD (.xy)

title: Quartz XRD (PANalytical XRDML)
learn: Instrument XML scan with start/end positions and a counts list.

title: α-quartz structure (CIF)
learn: Crystal structure: Wavenum computes its Cu Kα powder pattern.
